column1: # Tuned GEMM table for gfx1201 (AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700), written by turbine_gemm_tune on 2026-09-27

# ROCm 7.14.1, hipBLASLt 1.4.1; shapes kernels/rocm/tuning/gemm_shapes.txt (llama.* invariant rows tuned in mode prefix on 2026-09-27; llama.* speed rows kept from the 2026-09-27 speed tune, clipped to m <= 64); tensor-parallel 2 shapes (llama.tp2.*, olmoe.tp2.*) added on 2026-09-28 in their model's mode on GPU 0, the rest kept (olmoe.tp2.q|k|v with --max-prefill-loss 0.15: its only row-invariant class is 9 % over the heuristic at m = 2,048); every tp 2 shape and llama.gate|up (the tp 2 fused gate/up) re-tuned the same day with the 17-row class signature (the 2-row one merged solutions of different summation orders into one class); llama.kv's invariant rows (tp 1, unfused K or V) re-tuned 2026-09-28 with the 17-row signature too (its old class mixed summation orders), its speed rows kept
